title: IMM-Core: Interview Metadata Model — Core Profile
description: A generic, openly published minimal metadata model for interview-based qualitative research. Discipline-agnostic (oral history, sociology, anthropology, education, migration studies, health research). Two-layer architecture: Core Profile (generic, 13 fields, 4 blocks) plus Implementation Profiles (specialisations). LuxOH-CMDI (C²DH, University of Luxembourg) is the first registered profile. Includes DCTAP single source of truth, JSON Schema validator, two example records, three crosswalks (Dublin Core, REFI-QDA/QDPX, Schema.org/Dataset), two worked profiles, and full conceptual documentation.

creators.name: Behnam Shad, Klaus
